It’s not new for a subprime consumer seeking auto financing to ask, “What vehicles fit my monthly budget?” or “Can I qualify?” But perhaps illustrating the current state of the car business, the inaugural FlexPath DXP Automotive Shopper Credit & Payment Behavior Study showed super-prime consumers are asking the same questions nowadays, too. stories.title: Volvo Cars to cut 2,500 jobs as Q3 swings to loss
stories.summary: Volvo will cut 2,500 jobs, mostly in Sweden, and trim another 5 billion crowns ($503 million) in costs after a third-quarter loss tied to Chinese competition, U.S. tariffs and weak demand.
